intro: Chanakya University, Bengaluru offers B.Sc programmes with a recorded year tuition in our database opened in {{year}}. The other college named in this article, Mahtma Gandhi Professional College of Nursing, has no B.Sc programme, fee or placement data on this page.

Chanakya University vs Mahtma Gandhi Professional College of Nursing is therefore a one-sided comparison until the second college's B.Sc records appear. This page does not invent missing programmes or fees.

sections.heading: Chanakya University vs Mahtma Gandhi Professional College of Nursing for B.Sc: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: The only college with B.Sc data on this page is Chanakya University. Our records list year tuition of ₹75,000 for B.Sc programmes in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Physics and Computer Science. There is no Chanakya B.Sc placement row here.

Mahtma Gandhi Professional College of Nursing, as the college is listed in our records, has no B.Sc programme data on this page. This article does not treat a blank side as a cheaper or weaker option.

sections.heading: Fees: official figures and recorded year tuition
paragraphs: Our records still show ₹75,000 a year as tuition for the listed three-year B.Sc programmes at Chanakya University. The official 2026-27 fee page does not list those exact three-year titles. It does list four-year B.Sc Honors (Physics & Chemistry) and B.Sc Honors (Psychology) at tuition of ₹1.25 lakh a year, with a first-year payable fee of ₹1.30 lakh and a four-year total of ₹5.05 lakh.

Because the official table and the recorded programme names do not match cleanly, this page does not treat ₹75,000 as a confirmed 2026-27 fee. Confirm the current official circular for the exact B.Sc you want.
There is no fee record here for Mahtma Gandhi Professional College of Nursing.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Neither side has a B.Sc placement row on this page. Do not use a package from another course or another year as a substitute.
Ask Chanakya University for its latest official undergraduate placement report, and ask the nursing college only if it actually offers the B.Sc you are comparing.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is listed for Chanakya University's B.Sc programmes in our records on this page. Admissions may use Class 12 marks or CUET.
Read the official admissions page for eligibility. For the nursing college, first confirm whether a B.Sc programme is offered in the current year.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Chanakya University is listed at its Devanahalli / Brigade Orchards campus on the Bengaluru outskirts.
This page has no usable location data for the second college, because that side did not load in the comparison. Confirm any campus address from an official source.
